name: Zombuul
ability: Each night*, if no-one died today, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you die, you live but register as dead.
designRole: Conditional kills and a first apparent death while still alive; makes apparent death unreliable.
explanation: Conditional kills and a first apparent death while still alive; makes apparent death unreliable.

nightInstructions.otherNights: If no one died today, the Zombuul chooses a player. :reminder:

jinxes.reason: If the Summoner summons a dead player into the Zombuul, the Zombuul has already "died once".
